entries.appliesTo: Tennessee advisory commission on intergovernmental relations (TACIR)

sources.program: § 1 — 'The Tennessee advisory commission on intergovernmental relations (TACIR) shall conduct a study of the potential regulation of artificial intelligence systems and generative artificial intelligence chatbots in this state.'

flags: study-and-report only: § 2 requires TACIR to 'publish a report of the study''s findings and recommendations' and deliver it to the governor, both speakers, and the legislative librarian — a report duty with no matching duty key
no report deadline stated in the text
no compliance obligations on private parties; § 3 directs state and local governmental entities to 'provide information requested by TACIR' 'to the extent permitted by law'
no penalty or enforcement provision (no exposure block)
LegiScan relation: crossfiled with HB 1946; the act itself states 'Substituted for: House Bill No. 1946' — SB 1700 is the enacted vehicle (Public Chapter No. 1082), not a duplicate
